currentState: Saved is a desktop page on a phone: display-size hero with a halo glow and a big Florilegium card, then up to 8 graphite cards (one per kind) with tinted icon tiles, an X on every row, and a Saved/History segmented control.

Highlights are not in Saved at all: only bookmarks (purify:bookmarks) are listed. Verse words are hidden behind a 'Show text' toggle, drawn with a left side stripe (border-l-2), and fetched with plain fetch('/api/bible/verse'), which has no server inside the apps (app/api is stashed out of the static export), so the toggle shows 'Couldn't load the text' on every phone app and offline. Other callers use apiFetch.

Remove is immediate with no undo. For a signed-in reader it does not stick: lib/sync/bookmarks.ts only inserts, and SyncBridge pulls on every (app) page mount, so a removed verse, chapter or writing comes back.

Annotation sync is insert-only too: an edited verse note never reaches the server, and pullServerAnnotations writes the server's first copy back over the local edit on the next page load. Removing a highlight comes back the same way. The annotations table has no color column, so every pull resets a highlight's colour to the default yellow.

The journal is only verse notes (lib/bible/journal.ts reads annotations). There is no Write button, no entry of its own, no prompts, no kinds. It groups by month, links each entry to its verse, and draws the reference in gold (text-premium-ink). Desktop hero frame on phones.

Plans: three tiles, gold progress bars (bg-premium) and gold streak text, emerald done circles. A plan page is chapter pills that drop the reader into /bible with nothing around them, and a 'Mark as read' button back on the plan page. No intro, no notes, no questions, no saying, no finish, no tomorrow, no sense of the path beyond an 89-row list. Progress is device-only.

Plus: /plans/[id] and /journal swap the whole page for PlusGate (hidden rather than shown with the mark); the plans list does show the Plus chip on Start and opens the upgrade sheet. JournalClient and PlanClient each read entitlements themselves instead of usePlusFeatures.
/plans and /journal light no tab in the apps (MobileTabBar has no matcher); /saved lights You (pinned by export-walk).

buildSteps.step: 0. Make removals and edits stick before anything swipes (sync fixes and the owner's SQL)
1. Shared pieces this area needs (built once, used by Saved, the journal and plans)
buildSteps.detail: SwipeRow: a list row that follows the finger leftwards (rightwards when dir is rtl, for ar and ur), touch-action pan-y, pointer events written to the DOM through refs (the useDraggableSheet way, no React state per frame); past 40 percent of the width or a fast flick it commits: the row collapses its height in 200ms (motion-safe:, a dissolve under data-motion=reduce), softTick(), onRemove(). Swipes that start within 24px of the leading edge are ignored (iOS back swipe, Android back gesture). The revealed action is the word Remove on a paper/10 ground, no red, no icon. Keyboard and pointer: a Remove text button at the row's end, visible on hover (md:) and on focus-visible, so the action is never swipe-only. UndoBar: one bar at the foot over the tab bar and the mini player (the ReadingsFlowBar shell's now-playing-lift + translateY(-var(--now-playing-h)) pattern), 'Removed' + Undo, 5 seconds, role=status; a second removal replaces the first and commits it; useUndo(commit, restore) owns the timer. FlowBarShell: ReadingsFlowBar's Shell() moved out unchanged, so the readings bar and the plan bar are one component; ReadingsFlowBar imports it (no behaviour change). FinishMoment: a 56px paper circle whose check is drawn by stroke-dashoffset in 420ms (motion-safe:, plain check under reduce), a Lora heading and one line; the readings flow's finished state can adopt it later. Sheet gains a `fill` mode: the panel is sized to useVisibleFrame (top, height), capped at 100 percent of that box, so a sheet with a field sits above the keyboard (the Ledger fix of 2026-10-04); scrim keeps pointer events, box is pointer-events none. Every new animation class in globals.css gets a :where([data-motion="reduce"]) escape and fills backwards (motionDoctrine, noPermanentStackingContext).

buildSteps.step: 2. Saved data: one feed of bookmarks and highlights, with words that work offline
buildSteps.detail: lib/saved/feed.ts (pure): savedFeed(bookmarks, highlights) -> SavedItem[] where a highlight is read from purify:bible:* annotations with highlighted or highlightedWords. One row per thing: a verse that is both starred and highlighted is ONE row carrying both flags and its colour. Sort newest first by addedAt or the annotation's new `at`; undated highlights (made before step 0) after the dated ones, canonical order. FILTERS: all; verses (bible-verse bookmarks); highlights (any highlight); prayers (prayer, prayer-rule); saints (saint, writing-section); readings (bible-chapter, history-event, walkthrough-card); icons (product, shown only when present); history (the existing reading history and recent prayers). chipsFor(items) returns only chips with items. matchesQuery(item, q) over words, title and source. Saint-paragraph highlights are left out of this release (naming them needs a work-title lookup; do not import the saints registry into /saved). lib/saved/verseWords.ts: words for a verse from textOf(verseKey()) (lib/remember/schedule.ts) first, else apiFetch('/api/bible/verse?book&chapter&from&to') batched per chapter (the route takes ranges, so one request per chapter), each result kept with keepText; offline with nothing kept shows 'Open to read' instead of an error. VerseRow: call keepText(...) when a highlight is first applied (applyColor, toggleHighlight, toggleWordRange), as it already does when a verse is starred. highlightColors: default meanings come from the catalog (bible.highlight.<id>) through t(); a reader's own renamed meaning still wins. Tests: merge and one-row-per-verse, ordering with undated last, every chip's membership, the history chip only when history exists, query matching.

buildSteps.step: 3. Saved screen: one list, chips, clean rows, swipe with undo
buildSteps.detail: Page: MobileTopBar titleKey=common.saved back=/account on phones (add /^\/saved$/ to OWN_HEADER_PATTERNS, which lib/nav/__tests__/backBar.test.ts requires); the desktop title block becomes `hidden md:block native-md-hidden` so a tablet in the app never shows two h1s; drop the page-halo glow on phones; content max-w-[760px] centred on desktop and tablet (the tablet pass). SavedList is rewritten as the feed: FlorilegiumRow first (one slim row: The Florilegium, '{n} lines' or the Plus chip when locked, a drawn ChevronLeft mirrored for the way in; same upgrade.open('florilegium') behaviour; the old card and its '→' go), then ChipScroller with the chips from chipsFor, a search field once there are 12 or more items, then the rows. SavedRow: line 1 small (text-caption, paper/55): the kind, with a 10px dot in the highlight's swatch colour before it for a highlight ('Highlight · Key verse', the reader's legend meaning), the date at the end; line 2: for a verse its words in Lora (text-body, 3-line clamp, words fetched as the row scrolls into view), for anything else its title (DM Sans semibold); line 3 small: where it is from (John 3:16; St John Chrysostom · Homilies on Matthew). A word-level highlight shows its highlighted words at full paper and the rest of the verse at paper/70. Tap opens it at its place (bookmarkHref, the verse anchor). Hairline dividers (divide-paper/8), no cards, no icon tiles, no side stripe. SwipeRow + UndoBar: in a chip, remove clears what that chip shows (Verses: the star; Highlights: the highlight, keeping any note); in All it clears both, and Undo restores both (bookmarks.restore, writeVerseAnnotation with the previous value). History chip: the old HistoryTab as the same clean rows with Clear history (pending the owner's answer). Empty: no card; the Star icon inline and one line, 'Tap the star on a verse to keep it here.' Deep link: /saved?kind=icons (read from window.location.search in an effect, no useSearchParams) so the shop's Saved sub-tab opens on icons; YouMobile's Verses stat opens ?kind=verses and Notes opens /journal. SavedPreview: replace the '→' strings with plain words plus a drawn chevron (ui.savedArrow, ui.allSavedCount lose the arrow in all 21 catalogs).

buildSteps.step: 4. Journal data: entries of its own beside the verse notes, synced
buildSteps.detail: lib/journal/entries.ts: JournalRecord = { id (uuid), kind: 'reflection' | 'prayer' | 'question', body, prompt?: { key?: string; text: string }, source?: { type: 'verse', book, chapter, verse, label } | { type: 'chapter', book, chapter, label } | { type: 'plan-day', planId, day, label }, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt? }; localStorage purify:journal, event purify:journal, useSyncExternalStore with a cached snapshot (the lib/plans/progress.ts idiom); addRecord, updateRecord, removeRecord (sets deletedAt, the tombstone), restoreRecord. A draft lives in purify:journal.draft. lib/journal/feed.ts (pure): journalFeed(verseNotes from lib/bible/journal.ts, records) -> JournalItem[] (verse notes count as reflections with a verse source), newest first; byDay(items) keyed by the reader's local day (replaces byMonth on screen; keep byMonth exported until its test is moved); filterKind; planPrompts(plansState, records, dismissed, guide) -> the questions of the LATEST finished plan day not yet answered (never a backlog wall); emptyPrompt(date) -> one of seven gentle prompts by weekday. lib/sync/journal.ts: push upserts changed records by id (onConflict 'id'), pull merges by updatedAt (newer wins), deletedAt travels both ways; listens to purify:journal in SyncBridge with the same 500ms debounce; canSync gates it like the others. Tests: byDay grouping across midnight and time zones (civil day), kinds filter, tombstoned records hidden, prompts only from the latest finished day and gone once answered or dismissed; sync pull and push in the pull.test.ts idiom.

buildSteps.step: 5. Journal screen: by day, Write always in reach, full-screen writing with the source on top
buildSteps.detail: Page: MobileTopBar titleKey=journal.title back (OWN_HEADER_PATTERNS gets /^\/journal$/); keep the English title 'Your journal' exactly (export-walk finds the screen by it). Entitlement through usePlusFeatures; locked: PlusGate stays (gating unchanged) but drawn inside the phone frame, with WriteButton carrying PREMIUM_CHIP and opening upgrade.open('journal'). Feed: JournalPrompts card first when planPrompts has questions ('From your reading plan', each question in Lora; tap opens the composer with that question and the plan day attached; Not now dismisses that day), else the existing From this day row; ChipScroller All, Reflections, Prayers, Questions; search once there are more than 5; then day groups headed Today, Yesterday (Intl.RelativeTimeFormat, as dayBucket does) or the weekday and date. Each entry: the words first (Lora, text-body, 4-line clamp, paper/90), then one small line: kind · source (John 3:16; Day 6 · Matthew 6) · time. No gold anywhere. Tap opens the composer on that entry; SwipeRow deletes with UndoBar (a verse note clears its note and keeps its highlight; a record gets deletedAt). WriteButton: a paper pill with the Pen icon, h-12, bottom centre above the tab bar and the mini player (now-playing-lift), always shown on phones; on desktop it sits at the end of the title row. JournalComposer: a full-height movable sheet (Sheet fill mode, so it rides above the keyboard; pull down or Android back closes it and keeps the draft), header Cancel on the start side and Done on the end side (paper pill), then the source card (a verse's words in Lora with its reference and an Open link; a plan day's reference and the question), then three small kind pills (Reflection, Prayer, Question), then an auto-growing textarea in Lora, text-body, leading 1.7, autofocused; the focused line scrolls into view inside the sheet on resize and focusin. A verse-note entry saves through writeVerseAnnotation (noteAt kept as setNote does); everything else through addRecord/updateRecord. Desktop: the same component as a centred panel max-w-[720px] (desktop prop). Empty journal: no blank page, one prompt card (emptyPrompt) with Write, and one line: 'Or tap the pen on a verse to write a note on it.'

buildSteps.step: 6. Plan guide content: intro, questions and a saying for every day, verbatim where it is the Fathers
buildSteps.detail: lib/plans/guide.ts: dayGuide(planId, index) -> { introKey: 'plans.<id>.d<N>.intro', questionKeys: ['plans.<id>.d<N>.q', two from the plan's pool 'plans.<id>.q.<k>' rotated by day], saying: Saying | null }. Catalog content: one intro of one or two lines per day (what to watch for, one line of context) and one question about that day's passage, plus a pool of 8 questions per plan; 140 days in all (psalter 20, gospels 89, proverbs 31). Written as canonically as possible, nothing invented about the text, and every plan marked clergy-pending in docs/plans/REVIEW.md (no priest reviews now). Example, gospels day 5 (Matthew 5): intro 'The Sermon on the Mount begins. Watch for whom Christ calls blessed, and how He fulfils the Law rather than setting it aside.'; question 'Which of the Beatitudes asks the most of you this week?'. data/plans/sayings.json: per plan and day { text, author, work, citation, from } where text is an excerpt copied verbatim from a bundled public-domain file: data/bible/commentary/<book>/<n>.json for the Gospels (Chrysostom, Cyril, Theophylact first) and the Psalms (St Augustine, the only Father in that file, venerated as Blessed Augustine; flagged in REVIEW.md), and data/saints/<saint>/<work>.json for Proverbs (Cassian's Conferences and Institutes, Chrysostom's homilies, Gregory's Morals quote it). A day with no verbatim match gets no saying, never a paraphrase. English only (about 45 KB once, not per language); other languages show it in English with a one-line note (content.notYetTranslated.saying, in the content.notYetTranslated.* family). Example for gospels day 5, verbatim from data/bible/commentary/matthew/5.json: 'instructing us to do nothing for display, and to separate ourselves from the tumults of ordinary life', St John Chrysostom, Homilies on the Gospel of St. Matthew, Homily 15, NPNF1-10. Minutes per day: computed at build in app/(app)/plans/[id]/page.tsx from data/bible chapter word counts with readingMinutes (lib/bible/readability.ts), passed to the client as a number[]. Tests: every day of every plan has its intro and question in en.json; every pool key exists; every saying's text is found in its `from` file after whitespace normalisation (the verbatim guard) and carries author, work and citation; no em dash in data/plans; dayGuide out of range is null. Size: about 30 KB of English per catalog, so roughly 0.6 MB on disk and 0.2 MB packed across 21 catalogs against 0.6 MB of headroom: measure with scripts/export-size.mjs after English plus one language before translating the rest (see needsFromOwner).

buildSteps.step: 7. The plan session: Begin, the plan bar inside the chapter, Done
buildSteps.detail: lib/plans/session.ts mirrors lib/readings/flow.ts: sessionStorage purify:plans.session = { planId, day, items: PlanReading[], at, on: localDay }; startPlanSession(plan, day) (calls leaveReadingsFlow(), and startReadingsFlow calls leavePlanSession(), so only one bar is ever up), goToPlanReading(at), finishPlanSession() -> completeDay(plan, day) (keeps the strand and the plan:<id> badge mark exactly as now) and sets purify:plans.justFinished = { planId, day }, leavePlanSession(), usePlanSession(). PlanFlowBar on FlowBarShell, mounted in ChapterScreen beside ReadingsFlowBar: small line 'Day 6 of 89' (and '2 of 8' on a kathisma day of several psalms), the reference in semibold, a leave X (44px), and Next: Psalm 10 or Done. Done: finishPlanSession(), softTick(), router.push('/plans/<id>'). MobileNextChapterFab hides while either flow bar is up (two 'next' controls on one screen otherwise). Tests: a psalter day of 8 psalms walks to Done; Done completes the day and marks the strand; starting a plan session leaves the readings flow and the reverse; a session from yesterday is ignored.

buildSteps.step: 8. The plan's home: intro card, path, finish moment, questions to the journal, the saying, tomorrow
buildSteps.detail: Both pages get MobileTopBar (Reading plans, back /bible; a plan's name, back /plans) and OWN_HEADER_PATTERNS entries /^\/plans$/ and /^\/plans\/[^/]+$/; desktop title blocks hidden md:block native-md-hidden. Gold leaves: progress fills and the streak in paper, done circles in paper with the Check icon, not emerald; the Plus chip is the only premium ink. /plans: started plans first as rows (name in Lora, 'Day 6 of 89 · Matthew 6', a 4px paper progress line, Continue), then the rest (name, one line, '{n} days · about {m} min a day', the Plus chip when locked). A row opens the plan page; there is no separate Start on the list. /plans/[id]: PlusGate goes; everyone sees the plan (shown with the mark, never hidden). PlanTodayCard is the intro card: 'Day 6 of 89' small, the reference in Lora (text-title-sm), the intro, 'about 5 min', Begin (paper, h-12): Plus -> startPlan if needed, startPlanSession, router.push to the first chapter; locked -> Begin carries the Plus chip and opens upgrade.open('plans'). PlanFinish, shown above everything when justFinished matches: FinishMoment ('Day 6 is read', '{n} days in a row'), then PlanQuestions (each question in Lora with a one-line Input, placeholder 'A line, or skip'; Keep in my journal saves each answered one as a 'question' record with prompt and the plan-day source; Skip saves nothing and the questions wait in the journal's prompt card), then PlanSaying ('From the Fathers', the excerpt in Lora, one cite line, the English note in other languages), then Tomorrow (day number, reference in Lora, the first line of its intro), then Back to the plan. The last day shows plans.finished and Start over. PlanPath: the window that matters (the last two days read, today lit with a paper ring and 'Today', the next four dimmed), each a row with a 44px status circle (Check when read, the day number when not; tapping a read day's circle unmarks it as now) and its reference; 'Every day of the plan' expands the rest grouped by book or kathisma. No connecting line or drawn decoration (the owner flagged 'the line' on walkthroughs). Motion: rows rise as they scroll into view with a CSS scroll-driven animation (animation-timeline: view(), inside @supports, motion-safe, the .account-reveal precedent), today's circle fills when the finish view lands; everything has its data-motion reduce escape.

/plans and /journal light the Bible tab (they are entered from its study row); add them to the Bible matcher and to the export-walk loop at line 1655 (["/plans/", nav.bible], ["/journal/", nav.bible]). Leave BibleStudyRow exactly as it is: export-walk (lines 1788, 1813) holds its link texts to the plain titles and forbids a pill or gold there, so the Plus mark lives on the destination screens. New walk checks at 390x844 phone: /saved seeded with a starred verse, a highlighted verse and a writing shows one list, the verse's words, a colour dot, no border-l; a swipe removes and Undo brings it back; /plans/gospels Begin lands on Matthew 1 with the plan bar, Done lands on the finish view with questions, a saying and tomorrow; /journal Write opens the composer above a stand-in keyboard (replace window.visualViewport before load, as the Ledger fix did). Then Impeccable's check and a look by eye on each screen (no stripes, sparkles, tinted boxes, glyph icons, gold) and the tablet pass (one centred column, nothing off centre).

buildSteps.step: 10. Content pass and translation (the long pole)
buildSteps.detail: Write the 140 intros, 140 day questions and 24 pool questions in English, choose the sayings by reading the commentary for each day's chapter, then translate the catalog content into the other 20 languages through scripts/i18n-batch.mjs (the agent is the pipeline; no paid APIs). Sayings stay English. Every new string: no em dashes (catalogs.test.ts checks all 21), placeholders kept, sentence case. Mock each of the three screens (two options each if he wants that) and send them before building steps 3, 5 and 8.

sharedPiecesNeeded: The shared phone top bar of note 10 (until it lands: MobileTopBar with back, plus the OWN_HEADER_PATTERNS entries).
The phone page frame of pattern 1 (compact header, no desktop hero on phones, sheets for detail): Saved, the journal and plans should be early users of it.

Sheet `fill` mode on useVisibleFrame, so any sheet with a field rides above the phone keyboard.
ChipScroller for every filter row; ChevronLeft (mirrored) wherever a '→' or '›' glyph remains.
The Plus mark: PREMIUM_CHIP plus upgrade.open(feature) through usePlusFeatures, one request per page.
Tombstone-aware sync (lib/sync/tombstones.ts), which other synced stores (florilegia) may need too.
Impeccable's check and a by-eye look before anything reaches him.

Content: 140 days of intros and questions written with no priest reviewing; written as canonically as possible, nothing invented about the text, every plan marked clergy-pending. Sayings must pass the verbatim test or be left out.
Two guided bars at once (the day's readings and a plan) would stack; the start functions must end each other.
export-walk pins the Bible study row (no gold, no pill, exact titles) and the 'Your journal' title; putting the Plus mark in the row or renaming the journal breaks the walk.
Plan progress is device-only while journal answers sync, so a reader on a second device sees answers for days their plan there has not reached.
Day keys: plan completion is filed under the civil day (todayKey), and the journal must group by the same local civil day, or entries written after midnight land on the wrong day.
Size of the work: three screens, a sync repair with SQL, two new stores, 140 days of content in 21 languages. XL; the content pass and translation are the long pole.
